label: IR-8(1)
title: Breaches

statement.prose: Include the following in the Incident Response Plan for breaches involving personally identifiable information:

children.label: (a)
children.prose: A process to determine if notice to individuals or other organizations, including oversight organizations, is needed;

children.label: (b)
children.prose: An assessment process to determine the extent of the harm, embarrassment, inconvenience, or unfairness to affected individuals and any mechanisms to mitigate such harms; and

guidance: Organizations may be required by law, regulation, or policy to follow specific procedures relating to breaches, including notice to individuals, affected organizations, and oversight bodies; standards of harm; and mitigation or other specific requirements.
